narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Four fiftieths is eight hundredths, which is zero point eight.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Eight hundredths is eight small squares out of a hundred.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Hundredths sit in the second place, so we need a zero first.
